lines: Furnished with proof but this, where the darbha-born body vibrates: there, by the yoga of offering prāṇa, mind, mantra, so may happen.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sapratyayā tviyaṃ yatra spandate darbhajā tanuḥ tatra prāṇamanomantrārpaṇayogāttathā bhavet
